## POLISH NOTES (react-and-trim pass)

- Opening 3 seconds: "You checked Stripe again" is the strongest possible hook - do not cut it or front-load any context before it
- Shot 5 (dollar amount) should hold 1 extra beat - pause in VO is deliberate, let the number breathe
- Shot 4 (single finding) is the weakest visually - if the finding still hasn't been generated, replace with a tight close-up of the cursor on the audit URL
- CTA card should be the longest static hold - 3 seconds minimum so the URL registers

## ASSEMBLY COMMANDS

```bash
# Generate shots list
cat > shots_list.txt << 'EOF'
file 'shot1.mp4'
file 'shot2.mp4'
file 'shot3.mp4'
file 'shot4.mp4'
file 'shot5.mp4'
file 'shot6.mp4'
file 'shot_cta.mp4'
EOF

# Concat shots
ffmpeg -f concat -safe 0 -i shots_list.txt -c copy raw_sequence.mp4

# Layer VO (convert ogg to aac first)
ffmpeg -i /home/mike/.hermes/cache/audio/tts_20260811_004139_953480.ogg voiceover.aac

# Mix
ffmpeg -i raw_sequence.mp4 -i voiceover.aac \
  -map 0:v -map 1:a -shortest -c:v copy -c:a copy final_16x9.mp4

# Burn captions (optional - or layer in CapCut)
ffmpeg -i final_16x9.mp4 -vf "subtitles=captions.srt" final_captioned.mp4

# 9:16 crop for Shorts/Reels
ffmpeg -i final_16x9.mp4 \
  -vf "crop=ih*9/16:ih:(iw-ih*9/16)/2:0" final_9x16.mp4
```
